records.claim: The time it takes the body to metabolize (process) medication is not the same for everyone. In healthy non-pregnant adults, it takes up to 1 week, on average, for most of the methotrexate to be gone from the body. Certain medications might affect how long methotrexate takes to clear from the body. Also, having reduced kidney function or other conditions that lead to extra body fluid might cause methotrexate to clear more slowly from the body.
records.source_section: I am taking methotrexate, but I would like to stop taking it before getting pregnant. How long does the drug stay in my body?
